2609.27092.title: Local Evidence and Geometric Readout Repair in Trained GNNs
2609.27092.paper_summary: Many node-classification GNNs apply a linear classifier to a nonnegative mixture of local messages. An error can reflect either poor mixture weights or a reachable logit set poorly positioned for the classifier. We separate these causes with an exact-mass linear program and two learned post-hoc repairs. Every reweighted prediction has an equivalent centered logit translation, but only translations in a message-induced displacement set are realizable by reweighting. Across eight datasets, eight GNN backbones, and ten splits, mean accuracy rises from 62.6% for the frozen models to 63.8% with reweighting and 65.3% with set-conditioned translation. A parameter-matched node-only translator reaches 64.6%, showing that translation explains most of the gain while the message set supplies a smaller additional benefit. Although oracle reweighting can correct many errors, label-free reweighting captures little of this potential: local evidence is often present but hard to select, and relaxing the evidence constraint is more effective than learning within it.
2609.27092.paper_summary_zh: 許多節點分類的 GNN 應用線性分類器於非負的局部訊息混合中。錯誤可能反映出不良的混合權重或可達的 logit 設置對於分類器的位置不佳。我們通過一個精確質量的線性程序和兩個學習的事後修正來區分這些原因。每個重新加權的預測都有一個等效的中心 logit 轉換，但只有在訊息引起的位移集中的轉換才能通過重新加權實現。在八個數據集、八個 GNN 骨幹和十個分割中，平均準確率從凍結模型的 62.6% 上升到重新加權的 63.8%，再到設置條件轉換的 65.3%。一個參數匹配的僅節點翻譯器達到 64.6%，顯示轉換解釋了大部分增益，而訊息集提供了較小的額外好處。儘管 oracle 重新加權可以糾正許多錯誤，但無標籤的重新加權幾乎無法捕捉到這種潛力：局部證據通常存在但難以選擇，並且放寬證據約束比在其中學習更有效。
2609.27092.author: Nadi Tomeh et.al.
